tools.name: publish_files
tools.description: Publish an artifact from files on disk. Omit slug to create a new artifact (private to you); to republish, give slug and base_version (the live version). Returns the slug, the new version and the claude.ai URL.

tools.name: read_declaration
tools.description: An artifact's declared capabilities (its database rules, downloads) and its live version.

tools.name: declare_capabilities
tools.description: Declare what an artifact's page may do (its database rules, the profile scope, downloads). Publishes a new version of the artifact itself and returns it.

tools.name: db_list
tools.description: List the documents of a collection in an artifact's database (each with its id and data), with a summary line (count, nextCursor).
